info.title: autorbac
info.description: Live, least-privilege RBAC discovery and assignment across Azure, Microsoft Graph (Entra), Microsoft Fabric, and Microsoft Purview, as a cross-platform .NET CLI. Resolves the least-privilege role(s) a command needs, tests whether a caller holds them, and emits idempotent grant/revoke snippets under Zero Trust principles.
